Prepare a per-cluster marker gene panel

Source: R/markers.R
prepare_marker_panel.Rd

Takes raw Seurat::FindAllMarkers() output (or any per-cluster marker data.frame with the same shape) and reduces it to the top marker genes per cluster used for CeNGEN scoring. Fold-change and adjusted p-value are used only to select which genes make the panel; once selected, every gene in the panel is treated equally by score_cengen_matrix().

Usage

prepare_marker_panel(
  markers,
  top_n = 20,
  cluster_col = "cluster",
  gene_col = "gene",
  p_val_adj_col = "p_val_adj",
  avg_log2FC_col = "avg_log2FC",
  max_p_val_adj = 0.05,
  only_pos = TRUE
)

Arguments

markers

A data frame of per-cluster markers, e.g. the output of Seurat::FindAllMarkers().

top_n

Number of top marker genes to keep per cluster (default 20).

cluster_col, gene_col

Column names identifying the cluster and gene.

p_val_adj_col, avg_log2FC_col

Column names used for filtering/ranking. Set to NULL to skip the corresponding filter/ranking step.

max_p_val_adj

Maximum adjusted p-value to keep. Ignored if p_val_adj_col is NULL.

only_pos

If TRUE (default), keep only genes with positive avg_log2FC (upregulated markers). Ignored if avg_log2FC_col is NULL.

Value

A tibble with columns cluster, gene, rank, n_requested, n_used (the last two constant within a cluster; n_used is the number of marker genes actually kept for that cluster, which may be less than top_n if fewer significant markers were available).
